description.text: Introduction The undergraduate program was established in 2009, which is named "EMIIT"-The Economics and Management International Immersion Talent Program. All courses in this program are taught in English and top international academic standards are applied. Students are under general economics and management education during their first and second year. In the third year, they choose two majors from the three that we offer: Economics, Finance and Accounting. materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. High school graduate Certificate 4. Transcript of high school 5. English proficiency test certificate IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English

requirements.text: 1. Applicants should be senior middle school graduates with a good command of English: TOEFL 79, IELTS 6.0, or other equivalent certificates (or sit for an English entry exam in our university). 2. Applicants should be in good health
